motif.name: Erda
motif.description: Passages of the piano score that match one melody, in levels by how close they are to it. Level 1 is the closest. A run of repeated notes counts as one note. Passages that overlap, or lie within 1 measure of each other, are joined into one; the level is that of the closest.

source.author: J. K. Holman
source.title: Wagner's Ring: A Listener's Companion & Concordance
source.publication: Portland, Oregon: Amadeus Press, 1996; paperback 2003, ISBN 978-1-57467-070-7

levels.label: Original
levels.name: The melody as given
levels.description: The melody as you gave it. It is not a passage of the score.

levels.name: Closest to the original
levels.description: The best partial matches of the whole phrase. The pitches and the rhythm are the same, in any octave.

levels.name: Same core pitches
levels.description: Notes 1 to 7 of the phrase have the same pitches, in any octave, but the rhythm differs.

occurrences.label: The original
occurrences.note: The melody as you gave it, engraved from your notes. It has no pickup, the bars are in 4/4, and the score has a bass clef and 4 sharps in the key signature. It is not a passage of the score.
